{{verse|chapter=2|verse=1|align=float}}{{dropinitial|A}}{{sc|Nd}} I (brethren) vvhen I came to you, I came not in loftine{{ls}}{{ls}}e of {{ls}}peache or of vvi{{ls}}edom, preaching to you the te{{ls}}timonie of Chri{{ls}}t. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=2|align=float}}† For I iudged not my {{ls}}elf to knovv any thing among you but {{sc|Iesvs}} Chri{{ls}}t, and him crucified. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=3|align=float}}† And * {{outside L|''Act. 18, 1.''}} I vvas vvith you in infirmitie, and feare and much trembling: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=4|align=float}}† and my {{ls}}peache and my preaching vvas not in the per{{ls}}ua{{ls}}ible vvordes of humane vvi{{ls}}edom, but in {{ls}}hevving of {{ls}}pirit and povver: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=5|align=float}}† that your faith might not be in the vvi{{ls}}edom of men, but in the povver of God.

But vve {{ls}}peake vvi{{ls}}edom among the perfect. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=6|align=float}}† but the vvi{{ls}}edom not of this vvorld, neither of the princes of this vvorld that come to naught: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=7|align=float}}† but vve {{ls}}peake the vvi{{ls}}edom of God in a my{{ls}}terie, vvhich is hid, vvhich God did prede{{ls}}tinate before the vvorlds, vnto our glorie: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=8|align=float}}† vvhich none of the princes of this vvorld did knovv: for if they had knovven, they vvould neuer haue crucified the Lord of glorie. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=9|align=float}}† But as it is vvritten, * {{outside L|''E{{ls}}a. 64, 4.''}} ''That vvhich eie hath not {{ls}}een, nor eare hath heard, neither hath it a{{ls}}cended into the hart of mā, vvhat things God hath prepared for them that loue him''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=10|align=float}}† but to vs God hath reuealed by his Spirit.
